# czc-v2026.10.22.6 (0.2.17.23)

Context overflows now reach clients in the form they act on, so Codex, chat
clients and Claude Code compact the conversation instead of failing on every
turn. Several local checks that counted base64 payloads as text no longer
reject or over-reserve real requests.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.22.5

### Context overflow signaling

- **Codex compacts on gateway-reported overflow.** Codex maps an overflow to
  `ContextWindowExceeded` (auto-compaction) only when it arrives as a streamed
  `response.failed` with `code: context_length_exceeded`
  (`codex-rs/codex-api/src/sse/responses_error.rs`). An HTTP 400 JSON body
  with the same code is a generic error. czc-v2026.10.22.5 claimed clients
  could auto-compact on its 400 JSON; that was wrong for Codex. Streamed
  `/responses` requests now receive that terminal event (HTTP 200, SSE) for:
  - the local synthesis budget overflow;
  - upstream overflow errors of any HTTP status (400, 413, 5xx), which were
    returned as 400 JSON or 502 `upstream_error`;
  - WebSocket v2 upstream `error` events, which Codex ignores as bare events;
  - the native Anthropic bridge ("prompt is too long", previously
    `server_error`);
  - exhausted request-body-size failover (see below).
  Non-streamed `/responses` requests receive HTTP 400 with the same code.
- **Chat Completions** returns HTTP 400 `invalid_request_error` with
  `code: context_length_exceeded` for upstream overflow (was 502
  `upstream_error` without a code).
- **Anthropic Messages** returns HTTP 400 `invalid_request_error` with
  `prompt is too long: ...` for upstream overflow (was 502 `api_error`), so
  Claude Code compacts.
- Anthropic's `prompt is too long` wording is recognised as an overflow.
- A `response.failed` that arrives before any output with `code: null` now
  gets `code: context_length_exceeded` (the upstream `type` is kept).
- **Request body too large on every account.** When all eligible accounts
  reject the body size (for example DeepSeek account 23164 returning
  `Failed to buffer the request body: length limit exceeded`, 6 times for one
  user), the client now receives `context_length_exceeded` instead of
  `413 Request payload is too large`, so it compacts. Per-request failover to
  other accounts is unchanged.

### No more duplicated error responses

- Local errors on the Responses path (codex_cli_only restriction, image
  permission, request validation, WebSocket fallback errors and others) now
  mark the response committed. The handler no longer appends a second
  `response.failed` with `code: upstream_error` after the JSON body, which made
  the body invalid JSON and hid the real code. Same for two Chat Completions
  writes and the Claude 5.5 request validation error.

### Token estimates that rejected or over-reserved real requests

- **Synthesis budget:** inline PDFs and other base64 files
  (`input_file.file_data`, `data:` URLs of any type, Anthropic base64
  `document` sources) are capped at 1600 tokens each instead of bytes/4. A
  4 MB PDF was estimated at about 1.3M tokens and rejected locally.
- **In-flight balance reservation:** the reservation estimated input as body
  bytes/4, including Codex reasoning `encrypted_content`, screenshots and
  files. User 222 had about $2 reserved per request while the real cost was
  $0.18–0.31, so parallel Codex turns were rejected with
  `余额不足 / insufficient balance` (385 rejections from 7 users in 3 days;
  the two largest counts are image-generation traffic, which this does not
  change). Images now count by pixel area, files are capped and
  `encrypted_content` is skipped. Bodies without such payloads are unchanged
  and not parsed. Output reservation and input pricing are unchanged.

### Official Codex clients

- An official client (User-Agent/originator) whose input starts with its own
  developer prompt no longer gets a default top-level `instructions` added,
  which sent the base prompt twice. Official clients without such a prompt
  still get the default. The OAuth passthrough path follows the same rule.
- Official clients are always classified native for synthesis, even when an
  account forces `codex_client_capability=compatible` (no account currently
  sets it).

### Content moderation: narrow pass on review capacity

- A candidate-tier keyword whose reviewed evidence came back **safe** was
  rejected with 413 `Risk-control evidence exceeds the review capacity` only
  because the text was longer than the review capacity (16 chunks of 4000
  characters). User 346 hit this 12 times in 3 days (`github token`, `博彩`,
  verdict safe, confidence 0.00–0.02). That case is now allowed and audited
  with decision source `evidence_capacity_exceeded_narrow_pass`; it is not
  cached, so each request is reviewed again. High-confidence and
  `contextual_review` tiers, unsafe verdicts and reviewer failures still fail
  closed with 413.

### Related fix outside this repository (deployed with this release)

- CLIProxyAPI `dev` 19864d57: the 1h cache-TTL routing estimate counted
  inline base64 images and files as text, so requests with screenshots were
  routed to the more expensive 1h cache write. It now uses pixel area for
  images and a capped estimate for other blobs (shared package
  `internal/tokenestimate`). The same estimate drives `AnthropicViewUsage`'s
  current-turn share on the Devin path: on turns with images, less of the
  cache write is moved back to plain input, so those turns are billed closer
  to Anthropic's own split (slightly higher, cache write is 1.25x input).
  Turns without inline media are unchanged.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.23`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in, no database migration and no configuration change.

## Compatibility

- Streamed `/responses` overflow errors are now HTTP 200 SSE with a
  `response.failed` event instead of an HTTP error status. Clients that only
  inspected the HTTP status for these cases will see the failure in the
  stream, as they already do for upstream-originated overflows.
- Upstream overflow on Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages is now HTTP 400
  instead of 502. Downstream gateways that retried those 502s will stop
  retrying a request that cannot succeed.
- Moderation is slightly less strict for candidate-tier keywords in very long
  text whose reviewed part is safe; everything else is unchanged.
- Not changed in this release (owner decisions): no per-account request body
  limit; Grok's local `grok_reasoning_window` fuse (480k, 0 occurrences in 14
  days) is left for the in-progress `fix/grok-abort-kilo-terminal` branch.

## Verification

Passed:

- `gofmt -l` on the changed Go files: clean.
- `go vet ./internal/service ./internal/handler`, `go build ./...`.
- `go test -count=1 ./...`: see the release check results below.
- New tests: streamed overflow writes exactly one `response.failed` with
  `context_length_exceeded` for upstream 400/413/502; non-streamed gets 400
  JSON; synthesis overflow (stream and non-stream); exhausted body-size
  failover for Responses (stream started or not) and Chat Completions; compat
  writers for Anthropic and Chat; Anthropic wording matcher; pre-output code
  fill; PDF and Anthropic document estimates; in-flight reservation estimate;
  developer-prompt detection; moderation narrow pass (safe allowed, unsafe
  blocked, eligibility matrix by tier/error/verdict).
- Updated tests that asserted the old 502/413 behavior.
- `-tags unit ./internal/service`: the only failures are the 12 that also
  fail on unmodified `dev-czc` (listed in the czc-v2026.10.22.2 notes).
- CLIProxyAPI: `go test ./internal/tokenestimate/... ./internal/translator/...
  ./internal/runtime/executor/...` pass except
  `TestRegressionIssue5910_UsageStatsCacheWriteTokensInResponses` and
  `TestRegressionIssue6505_DevinClaudeStreamingNoFullInputEstimate`, which
  fail on the base commit too.

Failed or skipped:

- golangci-lint is not installed locally; not run.
- Frontend source is unchanged; it was rebuilt only for the embed build.
- No live replay against the Codex upstream: request bodies are not stored,
  and an overflow cannot be produced on demand without a very large request.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.22.5`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.22.6-<UTC timestamp>` created during
this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. CLIProxyAPI: restore
`~/.local/opt/cliproxyapi/CLIProxyAPI.bak.20261022T161543Z` and restart
`cliproxyapi-devin.service` (user unit).
